coaching.headline: Countess ran Greystone over and we took ten towers to their two. The only giveaway was a free Fangtooth.
coaching.team: A proper win built on structures, not a kill count. We won seven of eight fights, turned five of them into an objective or tower, and our base lost two outer towers and nothing else.

focus.title: No free Fangtooth
focus.evidence: Their first Fangtooth fell with all five of us alive and no fight recorded around it. The second fell while we took Orb Prime and their inhibitor, which is a trade worth making. The difference is whether we took something in return.
focus.action: Before each Fangtooth spawn, the jungler calls contest or trade. A trade names the tower or Prime we take at the same time; if nobody can name one, all five go to the pit. Next game, no enemy Fangtooth falls for nothing while all five of us are alive.

perPlayer.cae6a91f-44c7-4dea-9cad-b5c187c3988a: Countess was a fucking nightmare for Greystone: first blood, seven of his eight deaths, the biggest hero damage in the lobby and a single death all game. That is the standard. The next step is turning his deaths into structures. When Greystone goes down and a friendly wave is near his tower, Countess calls the push and hits it with the wave before hunting the next kill.

cae6a91f-44c7-4dea-9cad-b5c187c3988a.matchup: Countess faced Greystone in the offlane and the observed result was one-sided: seven of his eight deaths were credited to her. Greystone's Tainted Bastion matters to her specifically, because it cuts the healing of whoever hits him with magical damage, and both her damage and much of her sustain are magical. Across the team, Greystone, Rampage and Sparrow bring physical damage, Renna the heaviest magical damage, and Phase the enemy healing.
cae6a91f-44c7-4dea-9cad-b5c187c3988a.build: This is pure magical damage with sustain layered in. Megacosm's burn adds damage based on bonus health, which Greystone's Overlord and Augmentation supply. Caustica ignores part of magical armor and gains damage against targets carrying bonus magical armor, such as Tainted Bastion or Rampage's Void Helm, while they are above half health. Overseer and Lifebinder return health through the ultimate and missing-health lifesteal. Final inventory does not show proc uptime or purchase timing.
cae6a91f-44c7-4dea-9cad-b5c187c3988a.eternal: Vesh adds a damage-over-time echo to ability damage on heroes; Lich adds magical lifesteal by level, and Mind Rot adds current-health damage to that echo. That fits a hero who lands repeated ability hits and heals off them. Tithe of Death is the alternative first minor, giving mana and permanent haste on takedowns, which suits a high-kill pace but gives up Lich's steady sustain.
cae6a91f-44c7-4dea-9cad-b5c187c3988a.augment: Sanguine Slash makes Blade Siphon hit harder and heal more against isolated targets. It rewards catching a lone offlaner, which suits this matchup, but the record does not show which kills came against isolated targets. Shadow Strike is the swap if getting Shadow Slip back sooner, for engages and escapes, matters more than extra damage on lone targets.
cae6a91f-44c7-4dea-9cad-b5c187c3988a.crest: Tempest pulses magical damage into nearby heroes for a short time and heals off the damage, with repeat hits on the same target reduced. It pays when Countess is inside two or three enemies, which matches her dive role. Active use is not recorded, so this is fit rather than proof.
cae6a91f-44c7-4dea-9cad-b5c187c3988a.improvement: Keep the damage-and-sustain package; one death across the match does not argue for a swap. If Sparrow or Rampage start finishing her in long fights, Golem's Gift is the conditional mage answer: physical armor and power in stacks that physical hero hits strip and casting restores. It gives up the raw amplification of a late damage slot such as Oblivion Crown. The missing physical armor is a draft-level warning here, not a proven cost.

729c3aa1-206a-4fe5-bd0e-216cc0ce10f8.matchup: Iggy & Scorch faced Renna, the enemy's heaviest damage dealer, and Renna was credited with all three of his deaths. Her Wraith Leggings add ability damage against low-health heroes and Overseer heals her off ultimate damage, so a low-health Iggy is the easy target. Rampage and Greystone are the bulky bodies his burn zones can grind down, and Phase plus Rampage's heavy self-healing made anti-heal relevant.
729c3aa1-206a-4fe5-bd0e-216cc0ce10f8.build: Megacosm and Entropy are the burn core, Noxia rewards following one ability's mark with a different ability, and Tainted Scepter adds healing reduction on magical damage plus Malice stacks. With Phase and Rampage both healing, that slot had a clear purpose, and it was the only anti-heal item on our team. It replaces Orb Of Growth's bonus experience and cast healing. The record does not show how often the anti-heal landed on the right target.
729c3aa1-206a-4fe5-bd0e-216cc0ce10f8.eternal: Vesh suits fire zones because repeated ability ticks keep feeding its damage-over-time echo; Mind Rot adds current-health damage, strongest at the start of a fight, and Lich gives magical lifesteal for lane sustain. Phylactery is the second-minor alternative if Renna's burst keeps ending him: after his ultimate it speeds up cooldowns and grants a mana-based shield, at the cost of Mind Rot's extra damage.
729c3aa1-206a-4fe5-bd0e-216cc0ce10f8.augment: Hold This! permanently grows Molotov's explosion damage against heroes each time the explosion hits one. It rewards a long game of Molotov hits, which this record cannot count. Turret Maniac is the alternative when zone control around an objective matters more than Molotov scaling, trading turret health for a fourth turret.
729c3aa1-206a-4fe5-bd0e-216cc0ce10f8.crest: Epoch puts Iggy into stasis briefly, letting enemy damage and zones play out while he cannot act. Against Renna, whose pull and ultimate zone set up her burst, it is the main tool for waiting out the dangerous part of her combo. The record does not show whether it was used before any of the three deaths, so its value here is fit, not proof.
729c3aa1-206a-4fe5-bd0e-216cc0ce10f8.improvement: If Renna keeps finding him, Spellbreaker is the conditional swap: magical armor plus a spell shield that blocks one incoming ability. It would give up Megacosm's health-based burn. Keep Tainted Scepter while Phase and Rampage are the healers the team needs to cut.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.matchup: Wukong's opponent was Rampage, who built Overlord, Elafrost and Void Helm and did the most healing in the lobby. Rampage got one kill all game, while Wukong killed him twice inside fights we won and never died. By kit, Sparrow and Renna are the fragile gank targets on their side; Greystone's bulk and Phase's healing make them poorer uses of a gank.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Manta Scythe speeds up camps and adds damage against targets with no ally nearby. Infernum burns a share of maximum health and deals more damage against enemies with bonus armor, which Rampage's Elafrost supplies. The Perforator ignores part of physical armor and slows on ability damage. Skipping Syonic Echo trades its post-cast attack-speed bursts for that armor penetration. Final inventory does not show purchase timing or proc counts.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Lotus grants a small random bonus periodically and on every takedown. Early Bloom adds an extra level at its threshold, and Immaculate reduces damage only while Wukong is near full health, so it protects the opening of a fight rather than the end of it. Masterpiece is the aggressive first-minor alternative, stacking damage and speed on kills; it trades a guaranteed level for value that only pays when kills come.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.augment: Masterful Mimicry raises the clone cap by one and generates Hair stacks over time. More clones means more bodies for enemies to sort through, which fits the stance-and-clone fight plan. Clone counts are not recorded. From Up High is the alternative only for a plan built around leap damage from height.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.crest: Nex stores part of the damage Wukong deals to heroes, then dashes and releases it as a burst with a short slow. It rewards trading first and finishing second, useful against a bulky jungler like Rampage once he is low. Activation is not recorded.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.improvement: Rampage out-healed everyone in the lobby. If that sustain starts winning jungle fights, Tainted Trident puts physical anti-heal on Wukong's hits, at the cost of The Perforator's armor penetration and slow. Keep the current build for now: Wukong killed Rampage twice and never died.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.matchup: Murdock and Steel faced Sparrow and Phase. Sparrow's three kills all landed on our duo, two of them on Murdock, and both carries have little escape by kit. Phase built damage items rather than a protective support core, so the enemy duo threatened burst. Rampage's Elafrost was the only completed physical-armor item on their team.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Lightning Hawk builds charge while moving or attacking and releases an empowered slowing shot, Imperator increases critical damage, and Vanquisher adds penetration and executes heroes left at very low health. That is the common carry core with nothing off-script, so there is no build deviation to explain. Final inventory does not show when each piece was online.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: Vermis adds maximum-health damage on every third consecutive basic attack on the same hero, and Serration adds missing-health damage to that hit. Melting Point only adds damage against very high physical armor, and only Rampage carried a physical-armor item. Sub-Surface is the second-minor alternative here: less damage from area abilities such as Renna's zones and Sparrow's arrow volley, at the cost of Melting Point's high-armor bonus.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.augment: Justice's Reach makes Shots Fired pierce units and reach further. Piercing helps when minions or the frontline stand between Murdock and Sparrow or Renna, and the extra range lets him deal that damage from further back. Sting Operation is the swap if more traps for self-peel matter more than reach.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.crest: Pacifier dashes, empowers the next physical hit, hits harder on low-health targets and can be recast after a quick kill. On an immobile carry it is also the main repositioning tool, so spending it forward removes the exit against Sparrow or Rampage. Use is not recorded.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.improvement: Keep the core. If Rampage's or Phase's healing starts keeping Murdock's target alive, Tainted Rounds adds anti-heal and on-hit damage that grows as the target's health falls, giving up Imperator's critical-damage boost. Iggy's scepter was the team's only anti-heal and only works when his magical damage lands on that same target.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.matchup: Steel supported Murdock against Sparrow and Phase. Phase ran damage items and Psychic Support rather than a protective core, so her threat was poke and healing. Renna was the enemy's heaviest damage dealer and it was magical, while Rampage did the most healing in the lobby. Steel's own kills on Phase and Sparrow show the duo pressure went both ways.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Fire Blossom burns nearby enemies and ramps while it keeps hitting the same target. Raiment of Renewal regenerates missing health out of combat. Dynamo makes immobilized enemies take more damage, which pairs with Shield Bash and the ultimate stun, and Xenia shields allies Steel stands next to while adding both armors. Fire Blossom takes the place of Gaia Greaves from the common core. Shield counts and Dynamo uptime are not recorded.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Krix increases maximum health. Regenerative Tissue heals after a break from hero damage, and Feeding Frenzy adds attack speed for each nearby enemy hero, which speeds up Heavy Metal's empowered punches in crowded fights. Festering Wounds is the draft alternative to Regenerative Tissue when anti-heal is short: Steel's stuns would then cut healing on Phase or Rampage, at the cost of recovery between trades.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.augment: Heavy Metal adds magical damage to heavy punches and Shield Bash based on total physical and magical armor. Fire Blossom, Dynamo and Xenia all add armor, so the build feeds it directly. That is how a tank build keeps threatening damage; the record does not split damage by source.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.crest: Tranquility heals Steel and nearby allies with a short burst of damage mitigation, raises the ward cap and pays gold passively. Twenty wards to Phase's nine shows the vision tools were used heavily; where those wards went is not recorded, so objective coverage is unknown.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.improvement: If Renna's or Phase's magical damage becomes the main threat to the backline, Tainted Bastion adds magical armor and cuts healing on whoever hits Steel with magic, which includes Phase. It would give up Raiment's large health pool and out-of-combat regeneration. Keep the current package while physical divers remain the main problem; one death all match does not demand a swap.

threats: Heal-stacking: Phase. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s), Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.
